bosses.name: Avaricious Vulcan
bosses.description: The ruler of the lower Demon Castle. Represents "Internal Greed" or distractions.

intel.lore: A giant gluttonous demon residing on the 50th floor. His hunger is endless.
intel.strategy: He is slow but deals massive area damage. Attack the legs.

bosses.name: Sillad (Monarch of Frost)
bosses.description: Represents "Emotional Coldness/Numbness."

intel.lore: The King of Snow Folk. He seeks to freeze the world into eternal silence.
intel.strategy: Equip Cold Resistance gear. His aura slows all actions. Fire damage is critical.

bosses.name: Atropus, The World Born Dead
bosses.description: A colossal, undead planet-sized entity resembling a rotting, shattered world drifting in space.

intel.lore: The afterbirth of creation, a stillborn god that seeks to return the universe to nothingness.
intel.strategy: You are fighting on its surface. The environment itself is hostile. Use flight and mobility. Avoid the necrotic waves.

bosses.name: Itarim (Outer God)
bosses.description: Beings from other universes. Represent "Unknown Future Challenges."

intel.lore: The Absolute Beings from far-off universes. They seek to reclaim the mana scattered across the worlds.
intel.strategy: Normal logic does not apply to a god from another universe. Use your Shadows to create an opening.

bosses.name: Querehsha (Monarch of Plagues)
bosses.description: Represents "Toxic Environments."

intel.lore: The Queen of Insects and the Monarch of Plagues. Her very presence breeds decay and pestilence.
intel.strategy: Do not let the parasites linger on your skin. Use area-of-effect fire spells to clear the swarm.

bosses.name: Ant King (Beru)
bosses.description: A monster that learns as it fights. Represents a task that gets harder the longer you take.

intel.lore: The pinnacle of the ant evolution. Created solely to destroy.
intel.strategy: Extremely fast. He can absorb skills from those he eats. Do not get caught.

bosses.name: Giant Arachnid Buryura
bosses.description: A gatekeeper of basic competence. Represents "sticky" problems that slow you down.

intel.lore: A monstrous arachnid that nests in the C-Rank dungeon. It feasts on unwary travelers.
intel.strategy: Its webs can immobilize you. Burn the webs and aim for the eyes.

bosses.name: Ashborn (Shadow Monarch)
bosses.description: The mentor/shadow self. Represents "Legacy."

intel.lore: The Greatest Fragment of Brilliant Light, who chose the power of Death.
intel.strategy: You cannot fight death itself. Prove your worthiness.

bosses.name: Tarnak (Monarch of Iron Body)
bosses.description: Represents "Stubbornness/Stagnation."

intel.lore: The King of Monstrous Humanoids. His body is as hard as the core of a star, making him a living fortress.
intel.strategy: His defense is nearly impenetrable. Use skills that ignore defense or high-level armor-piercing weapons.

bosses.name: Kargalgan (Orc Shaman)
bosses.description: An intellectual bully. Represents complex logic puzzles or high-level management hurdles.

intel.lore: High Shaman of the Red Orc tribe. He wields powerful dark magic.
intel.strategy: Target the shaman first. His curses debilitating. Interrupt his casting.

bosses.name: Nyarlathotep, The Crawling Chaos
bosses.description: A shifting, unrecognizable cosmic horror entity taking a vaguely humanoid silhouette wrapped in shadows.

intel.lore: He walks among men, sowing discord and chaos for his own amusement.
intel.strategy: He changes forms constantly, altering his weaknesses. Adaptability is key. Guard your sanity.

bosses.name: Apostles of Itarim
bosses.description: High-ranking invaders. Represent "Disruptive New Technologies."

intel.lore: High-ranking servants of the Outer Gods. They lead the incursions into other dimensions.
intel.strategy: They attack in perfect synchronization. Break their formation to weaken their defensive barrier.

bosses.name: Antares (Monarch of Destruction)
bosses.description: The Final Boss. Represents "Entropy and Chaos."

intel.lore: The King of Berserk Dragons. The embodiment of chaos and destruction.
intel.strategy: Survival is the only victory. His power is absolute.

bosses.name: Baruka (Ice Elf Leader)
bosses.description: Cunning and fast. Represents a competitor or a project that requires high mental agility.

intel.lore: Leader of the Hyakki. He betrayed humanity for survival.
intel.strategy: He uses stealth to strike from behind. Watch for the shimmer in the air.

bosses.name: Azathoth, The Blind Idiot God
bosses.description: An amorphous, horrifying cosmic entity of churning nebulous flesh, blind and screaming in the void of space.

intel.lore: He gnaws hungrily in the dark, surrounded by the piping of mad flutes.
intel.strategy: Do not wake him. Avoid prolonged combat. Burst damage is essential before his dream shifts.

bosses.name: Cerberus (Gatekeeper)
bosses.description: The brutal "Welcome" to the Demon Castle. A pure stamina and willpower check.

intel.lore: The three-headed watchdog of the Demon Castle. Its flames burn the soul.
intel.strategy: Keep moving. Its three heads strike independently. Rage mode increases speed drastically.

bosses.name: Statue of God
bosses.description: The "Architect's" test. It represents the moment you realize you must change or "die" (fail).

intel.lore: The creator of the System's test. It sits upon a massive stone throne.
intel.strategy: Follow the commandments. Do not look directly at the eyes when they glow.

bosses.name: Hwang Dongsuk
bosses.description: Represents social friction or toxic colleagues you must overcome.

intel.lore: An ambitious and cruel C-Rank hunter. He leads a party of 'lizards' who betray their colleagues for loot.
intel.strategy: A standard brute. He relies on his team usually, but alone he is just a loud-mouthed thug. Parry his heavy swings.

bosses.name: Yogumunt (Monarch of Transfiguration)
bosses.description: Represents "Self-Doubt."

intel.lore: The King of Demonic Spectres. A master of deception who can alter the fabric of reality within his domain.
intel.strategy: He attacks the mind as much as the body. Trust your perception, not your eyes.

bosses.name: The Architect (Kandiaru)
bosses.description: The one who made the rules. Overcoming this means you no longer need the "System" to guide you.

intel.lore: The designer of the leveling system. He serves the Shadow Monarch.
intel.strategy: He knows the system better than you. Expect rule-bending attacks.

bosses.name: Tiamat, The Chromatic Sovereign
bosses.description: A terrifying multi-headed dragon goddess of cosmic proportions, with scales reflecting all colors of the elements.

intel.lore: The Mother of Dragons, trapped between dimensions, seeking to reclaim the material plane.
intel.strategy: Each head breathes a different element. Counter with opposite elements if possible. Focus on one head at a time.

bosses.name: Blood-Red Commander Igris
bosses.description: The Job Change boss. He doesn't use magic; he uses pure skill. Represents your "Professional Certification."

intel.lore: The majestic knight protecting the empty throne. He awaits a worthy liege.
intel.strategy: A pure test of combat skill. High speed and defense. Do not rely on tricks.

bosses.name: Metus (Soul Shepherd)
bosses.description: A boss that throws "Busy Work" (minions) at you to drain your focus.

intel.lore: A guide for lost souls, or perhaps their jailor. He commands the dead.
intel.strategy: He summons endless waves of undead. Kill the summoner to stop the horde.

bosses.name: Rakan (Monarch of Beastly Fangs)
bosses.description: Represents "Unbridled Impulse."

intel.lore: The King of Beasts. He values strength above all and views humans as mere prey for his pack.
intel.strategy: He is the fastest of the Monarchs. Watch his eyes; he telegraphs his pounce with a brief flash of red.

bosses.name: Vecna, The Whispered One
bosses.description: A powerful undead lich god, robed in ancient necrotic garments and surrounded by forbidden magic.

intel.lore: He sacrificed an entire civilization to achieve godhood. His hand and eye are artifacts of immense power.
intel.strategy: He can steal your buffs and items. Maintain simple, brute force attacks. Magic is less effective.

bosses.name: Blue Venom-Fanged Kasaka
bosses.description: The first solo hurdle. Fast and punishing for beginners.

intel.lore: An oversized cobra with scales as hard as steel. It guards the subway entrance.
intel.strategy: Its scales are iron-hard until heavily damaged. Avoid the venomous breath at all costs.

bosses.name: Kamish (The Dragon)
bosses.description: The greatest calamity in human history. Represents a "Life-Defining Project."

intel.lore: The worst disaster in human history. A dragon that nearly destroyed the world.
intel.strategy: Humanity's greatest calamity. Only the strongest can survive his presence.

bosses.name: Baran (Monarch of White Flames)
bosses.description: Represents "Raw Ambition."

intel.lore: The King of Demons. He fought against the Shadow Monarch in the ancient war.
intel.strategy: He commands an army. Focus the Monarch. Avoid the blue lightning.

bosses.name: Legia (Monarch of the Beginning)
bosses.description: Represents "Physical Limitations."

intel.lore: The King of Giants. Captured by the humans long ago and drained of mana, his rage has only simmered and grown.
intel.strategy: He is slow but a single hit is fatal. Aim for his joints to slow him down further.
